description_en: Queries information about custom images that are shared across Alibaba Cloud accounts in a region
description_zh: 查询跨账号共享镜像的信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-custom-image-share-accounts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-2zehv38jjmwva1ee0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomImageShareAccounts

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared custom image
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size
